name: The Four-Source Convergence
description: Compromise confirmed by three engine-corroborated sources: memory (process injection posing as itself in lsass.exe), network (traffic contradicting the host's declared state), and disk (a beacon DLL with tampered timestamps posing as Windows Defender). A fourth source, TPM boot attestation, rules out pre-boot compromise as context — the current detector suite has no hardware-attestation category, so it isn't counted toward the engine's numeric corroboration.
devil_advocate: Each source alone could have a benign explanation, but the independent convergence points to the same actor and timeline. The TPM rules out pre-boot compromise.

custodyEvents.detail: EDR + network alerts correlated to one host.
Memory image, pcap, disk image and TPM quote acquired.
Deterministic engine ran over the acquired artifacts.

artifacts.description: PID 2244 injected into lsass.exe, presenting as the legitimate process while running injected code. Kernel structure anomaly confirmed.
DNS beacon every 300s ± 45s, consistent with Cobalt Strike's default beacon — the host has no declared reason to be contacting this domain at all.
Beacon DLL found in System32 posing as Windows Defender, with file timestamps altered to match legitimate system files. Hash matches a known beacon.

TPM PCR0 and PCR7 valid. Boot integrity intact. The attack is post-boot, runtime injection. No markers: this artifact shows the ABSENCE of anomaly (a clean boot), which is context that rules out a rival hypothesis, not something any of the 5 anomaly-detectors can score.

peirce_chain.firstness: Four independent artifacts pointing to the same compromise.
peirce_chain.secondness: Low cross-correlation: these sources cannot have been fabricated together.
peirce_chain.thirdness: Cobalt Strike beacon with process injection confirmed. Reliable evidence.

demo_quote: Four independent sources converge in the story; three of them are what the engine's detector suite can actually score today. The TPM's clean reading is real corroboration in the forensic sense — it rules out a rival hypothesis — even though it doesn't move the engine's corroborationCount. That gap is worth naming honestly rather than papering over.
